page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Page number and running head at the top. Two italic question headings and two roman title headings, with the text in paragraphs between them. A catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: Quot species liberorum vulgò nu-merantur?
main_text.p: Sex: prima species naturalium & legitimorum simul, secunda naturaliù tantùm, tertia legitimorum tantùm, quarta spuriorum seu vulgò quæsitorum, quinta incestuosorum & ex damnato coitu suscepto-rum, sexta spiritualium.
main_text.head: Qui sunt liberi naturales & legiti-mi simul?
main_text.p: Qui ex justis nuptiis, seu legitimo matrimonio nati sunt l. filium definimus. ff.de his qui sunt sui vel alien.jur.Vulgò Ehelicheꝫ gebohne Kinder [?]. Inter hosce liberos refert Schneidewinus per subsequens matrimonium legitimatos.
main_text.head: De horum successione sequentes ob-servandæ sunt Regulæ.
Prima Regula?
main_text.p: Liberi naturales & legitimi tàm masculi, quàm fœminæ, sive in patria potestate existentes, sive emancipati, hodie præferuntur omnibus aliis: Et suis ascendentibus æqualiter succedunt in capita. Authen. in successio̅n. C. de suis & legitimis liberis.

Obiter autem observandum, quòd successio in capita dicitur fieri, quando hæreditas secundùm numerum personarum, quibus defertur, dividitur in viriles seu æquales portiones, ut ibi tot sint partes, quot capita vel personæ, & unus tantùm habeat, quantum alter.

In stirpes verò fit divisio hæreditatis in portiones inæquales, quando plures succedunt in locum alterius, qui eam tantùm partem accipiunt, quam is, in cujus locum succedunt accepisset, & non numeran-tur succedentium personæ sive capita: sed unius tan-tùm

page.notes: The first letter of "Quot" and "Qui" and "Prima Regula" is a decorated initial; read as Q and R. The black letter words "Ehelicheꝫ gebohne Kinder" are read with doubt, especially "Kinder" (marked [?]). The line "Authen. in successio̅n." has a macron over the n; read as successionem and printed as is. Long s is set as plain s throughout. The catchword "tantùm" stands at the lower right, offset from the text.
